title: High-protein overnight oats
method: Stir the oats, chia and cinnamon together in a jar.
Whisk the whey into the milk until smooth, then stir through the oats with the yoghurt.
Top with berries, lid on, fridge overnight (minimum 4 hours).
Loosen with a splash of milk in the morning if it sets too thick.

title: Chicken teriyaki meal-prep bowl
ingredients: 600g chicken thigh fillet, trimmed and diced
1 tbsp sesame seeds, spring onion to finish
method: Cook the rice; steam the broccoli and carrot until just tender.
Brown the chicken in sesame oil over high heat, 6 to 8 minutes.
Add teriyaki sauce and reduce until it coats the chicken.
Portion rice, veg and chicken into 4 containers; finish with sesame and spring onion.
Keeps 4 days refrigerated.

title: One-pan salmon & greens
method: Oven to 200C. Toss asparagus and beans in half the oil on a tray.
Sit the salmon on top, skin down; season, remaining oil over the fish.
Roast 12 to 14 minutes until the salmon flakes.
Fold the spinach through the hot veg to wilt; squeeze lemon over everything.

title: Greek yoghurt berry parfait
method: Layer half the yoghurt, then half the berries and granola; repeat.
Drizzle honey over the top.
Assemble no more than a few hours ahead so the granola keeps its crunch.

title: Peanut-butter protein shake
ingredients: 1.5 scoops (45g) whey protein, chocolate or vanilla
method: Blend everything on high for 45 seconds until completely smooth.
Thin with water or milk to preference. Great post-session or as a meal bridge.

title: Beef & veg stir fry
ingredients: 1 tbsp peanut oil, garlic and ginger
150g cooked rice or noodles to serve
method: Get the wok smoking hot; sear the beef in batches, remove.
Stir-fry garlic, ginger and the veg 3 to 4 minutes, keeping bite.
Beef back in with the sauces; toss 1 minute until glossy.
Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Tuna & white bean salad
ingredients: 2 tsp olive oil, red wine vinegar, salt and pepper
method: Toss the beans, tomatoes, onion and leaves with oil and vinegar.
Flake the tuna through; season well.
Eat immediately, or pack the dressing separately for meal prep.

title: Egg white veggie scramble
ingredients: 250ml egg whites (about 8 whites) plus 1 whole egg
method: Soften the capsicum and mushrooms in the oil, 3 minutes.
Add spinach until wilted, then the egg whites and whole egg.
Scramble on low, pulling from the edges, until just set.
Season and serve on or beside the toast.

title: Slow-cooker chilli con carne
ingredients: 1 tin kidney beans, 1 tin black beans, rinsed
2 tbsp chilli powder mix (cumin, paprika, oregano)
method: Brown the mince hard in a pan first for flavour.
Everything except the beans into the slow cooker; low for 6 hours.
Beans in for the last 30 minutes.
Portion with rice into 6 containers; freezes well for a month.

title: Sheet-pan chicken fajitas
ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp fajita seasoning
Lime, coriander, light sour cream to serve
method: Oven to 220C. Toss chicken, capsicum and onion with oil and seasoning on one big tray.
Roast 18 to 20 minutes, tossing once, until charred at the edges.
Warm the tortillas; serve with lime and a spoon of light sour cream.
For prep, box the filling and tortillas separately.

title: Banana & whey protein pancakes
ingredients: Cooking spray, berries and maple to finish (counted)
method: Whisk everything into a thick, pourable batter; rest 5 minutes.
Cook 3 pancakes in a sprayed non-stick pan, medium-low, 2 minutes a side.
Flip when bubbles hold their shape at the edges.
Stack with berries and a teaspoon of maple.

title: Prawn & rice noodle bowl
ingredients: 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp lime juice, 1 tsp sugar, chilli
1 tsp sesame oil, mint and coriander
method: Soak the noodles per packet; refresh under cold water.
Sear the prawns in sesame oil 2 minutes until just pink.
Whisk fish sauce, lime, sugar and chilli into a dressing.
Toss noodles, veg and prawns with the dressing; herbs over the top.
